template: trade_when( less(days_from_last_change(vec_avg({stock_split_ratio_243})), 30), divide( divide(subtract(vec_avg({actual_eps}), vec_avg({estimated_eps})), add(abs(vec_avg({estimated_eps})), 0.01)), add(ts_mean(ts_backfill(divide(subtract(vec_avg({actual_eps}), vec_avg({estimated_eps})), add(abs(vec_avg({estimated_eps})), 0.01)), 5), 252), 0.001) ), 0 )
